name: Text-Driven Non-Photorealistic Scene Editing
definition: Stylizes VolVis scenes using text instructions via the IP2P model, using a one-time update strategy and reduced training views to maintain geometry consistency.
summary: Text-Driven Non-Photorealistic Scene Editing stylizes volume visualization by optimizing only texture attributes of Gaussian primitives using text prompts, preserving geometry and avoiding iterative blurriness.
